# Oracle spoiler fixtures

20 spoiler logs (10 per key_drop_shuffle setting) generated by Archipelago's OWN generator
(commit 1d8a6a556f32de4fb85feca2eafbea1ba605295e, matching tests/fixtures/ap-source/), run
outside this repository with `--spoiler_only` and the baseline settings:
standard · no glitches · dark_room_logic lamp · goal ganon · accessibility full ·
entrance vanilla · item_pool normal · item_functionality normal · progressive on.
Seeds 771-7710 per mode. The only generator modification was removing the base-ROM
existence assert (never the logic); no ROM was present or used.
(Regenerated 2026-08-27 with mode standard, replacing the original open-mode
set: the app's fixed baseline plays the vanilla escape intro, which is the
reference's standard mode.)

These are the parity oracle for the TypeScript port in shared/randomizer/ap-world/:
the port must judge every oracle placement valid and completable and reproduce each
spoiler's playthrough sphere structure. Data fixtures — never executed, MIT (see ap-source/LICENSE).
